Extensible Markup Language for storing a: Langue de balisage extensible pour le stockage et le transport des données
Build an XML document from JSON, with at: Build an XML document from JSON, with attributes, repeated elements, CDATA and an optional XML declaration
Field to add your tag's attributes: Champ pour ajouter les attributs de votre tag
Ignore XML tag attributes during parsing: Ignore XML tag attributes during parsing. When unchecked, attributes are included in the output with a "@_" prefix (e.g. id="42" becomes {"@_id": "42"}).
Each key becomes an element and each lis: Each key becomes an element and each list item becomes a repeated element. Keys starting with "@_" become attributes, "#text" sets the text of an element that has attributes, and "#cdata" writes a CDATA section. Example: {"book": {"@_id": "1", "title": "Dune", "tag": ["scifi", "classic"]}}. The output of Convert XML to JSON can be used as-is.
Wraps the output in one element with thi: Wraps the output in one element with this name. Leave empty if your JSON already has a single top-level key. If the JSON is a list or has several top-level keys and this is empty, "root" is used.
Element name for each item when the JSON: Element name for each item when the JSON itself is a list. Defaults to "item".
Put each element on its own line; text c: Put each element on its own line; text content is never changed.
Start the output with <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>. To use a different declaration, add a "?xml" key to your JSON instead, e.g. {"?xml": {"@_version": "1.0", "@_standalone": "yes"}}.
Write empty values as <tag/> instead of: Write empty values as <tag/> instead of <tag></tag>.
Keys starting with this prefix become at: Keys starting with this prefix become attributes. Defaults to "@_", the prefix Convert XML to JSON uses.
Key that holds the text of an element th: Key that holds the text of an element that also has attributes. Defaults to "#text".
Key whose value is written as a CDATA se: Key whose value is written as a CDATA section, so it is not escaped. Defaults to "#cdata".
Keep numbers that start with a zero as t: Keep numbers that start with a zero as text so values like ZIP codes, IDs and account numbers are not changed (e.g. "02134" stays "02134" instead of becoming 2134). Other numbers are still converted to numbers.
